title: Moss and the Seed Trail
note: b418 — Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week.

pages.brief: Moss the hedgehog standing by a wooden bird feeder, looking at a trail of scattered seed leading away from it.
Moss the hedgehog looking down at his own paws and spikes, puzzled.
Moss the hedgehog sniffing closely at the ground, following a line of scattered seed.
A trail of scattered seed continuing along the base of an old wooden garden fence.
A trail of scattered seed passing underneath a low wooden garden gate.
A trail of scattered seed ending at a small hole in the ground near a fence.
Pip the sparrow popping out of a small hole in the ground, a single seed held in his beak.
Pip the sparrow hopping along, a small seed dropping from his beak with each hop.
Moss the hedgehog grinning at Pip the sparrow, a trail of seed clearly leading back to him.
Moss the hedgehog and Pip the sparrow eating seed side by side at the base of a wooden bird feeder.
